statute_text: Standardization of Exclusion Clauses in Health Insurance Contracts: Insurers cannot deny claims under exclusions that are vague or non-specific. Prior approval or medical necessity justifications must be clearly established before rejecting claims.
Defines Unfair Trade Practice: Imposing unreasonable conditions, delayed claim processing without justifiable cause, or arbitrary reduction of claimed expenses constitutes unfair trade practice.
Claim Settlement Timeline: Insurers must settle or reject claims within 30 days of receiving all necessary documents. Interest at 2% above the bank rate is payable for delayed payments.

statute_name: CGHS Billing Guidelines & Package Rate Mandate
statute_text: Empanelled hospitals cannot charge rates higher than prescribed CGHS package rates for beneficiaries. Overcharging beyond ceiling rates is subject to refund and penalty under MoHFW circulars.
No manufacturer, distributor, or retailer shall sell any scheduled formulation at a price exceeding the ceiling price fixed by NPPA plus applicable GST. Overcharging attracts recovery with interest.
